svg.text: ResBack - Feature Class Diagram
Implemented classes grouped by feature. Shared classes repeated across panels represent the same class.
ResBack - Authentication, Accounts and Profiles
Dashed arrows show dependencies on the shared User model; all controllers extend Controller.
Registration creates students. Profile editing changes names and profile photos.
Account management is restricted to Admin and Super Admin; protected roles have further checks.
Login and Home route users by role. Authentication uses Laravel Auth and sessions.
Selected User members shown. Source: app/Http, app/Models and routes/web.php | 24 September 2026.
ResBack - Feedback Processing Classes
Selected feedback-processing classes. Solid arrows: stored service references; dashed: dependency.
+ public; # protected; - private. Constructors, private helpers and optional defaults omitted.
SentimentService calls the external Gemini API, saves SentimentResult and updates Feedback.
Rejected feedback bypasses analysis. Domain models and multiplicities appear in the core diagram.
Source: app/Http and app/Services | inspected 24 September 2026.
ResBack - Dashboard, Analytics and Report Features
Dashed arrows: selected dependencies. + public; ? nullable; underline: class-scoped member.
PDF reports use Dompdf; Excel exports use PhpSpreadsheet. Controllers extend Controller.
CATEGORY_LABELS is a class constant. DateRange is readonly. Parameter defaults are omitted.
rank() computes fresh results; rebuildCategory() persists rankings. Shared classes also appear in other views.
Source: app/Http/Controllers, app/Services, app/Support | inspected 24 September 2026.
Core model attributes and relationship multiplicities are documented in resback-class-diagram.
